title: W021.5 Telangana Assembly Constituency Boundary — ArcGIS candidate audit

source.publisher: Telangana State Remote Sensing Applications Centre GIS

retrieval.responseFormat: ArcGIS REST ESRI JSON; f=json required. f=geojson returned HTTP 400 output format not supported.

topologyAudit.method: Converted ESRI rings to Shapely geometries using clockwise exterior / counterclockwise hole convention; no raw source coordinates modified.
topologyAudit.coverageAgainstAuthoritativeStateBoundar: NOT CHECKED; absence of positive-area overlap does not prove no gaps

identityAndLegalChecks.canonicalAcNumberField: NOT PRESENT IN EXPOSED FIELD LIST; OBJECTID IS A DATABASE KEY, NOT A LEGAL AC ID

disposition: RETAIN AS OFFICIAL-STATE-GIS CANDIDATE ONLY; DO NOT ACCEPT OR IMPORT AS CANONICAL GEOMETRY YET
requiredNextActions: Run the corrected probe against the separate EndowmentLands_Admin_2026/MapServer/12 service and compare hashes, feature identities, extent, geometry and topology.
Acquire and cite the legally effective constituency roster/order and reconcile all 119 Assembly_Name values to canonical AC numbers.
Resolve the Dornakal (ST) self-intersection only in a derived artifact, with original geometry preserved and an explicit transformation record; do not overwrite raw source bytes.
Compare the union against an authoritative Telangana state boundary and verify no gaps, overlaps, slivers or out-of-state geometry.
Obtain source owner confirmation of effective date and terms for redistribution/use.
Retain the raw ESRI JSON artifact and manifest; artifact expires after 30 days unless preserved under an approved licensed source-data path.
